info.title: EPOS Data API (REST)
info.description:
REST contract that an external POS/EPOS system implements so Dojo products can
fetch and update commerce entities (Orders, Tables, Areas, Parties, Reservations)
and record payments. Use this when the EPOS exposes its own publicly reachable
HTTP endpoints; for on-premise EPOSes that cannot accept inbound HTTP, use the
[WebSocket variant](/epos-data-asyncapi/bundled.yaml) of the same contract.

Core modules:
- Tables
- Areas
- Orders
- Parties
- Reservations

API modules can generally be
implemented independently, with a small number of interdependent fields affected
by other modules (for example, if Parties are implemented & the information is
known, a `partyId` should be attached to an Order's `dineInDetails`).

All requests also contain special headers within the REST headers,
containing details about the requestor that can be used for logging purposes or EPOS business logic
(such as waiter id based access to entities).

Before any of these endpoints will be invoked by Dojo, register the capabilities you implement with `PUT /epos/integrations/rest`. See the EPOS Data API guide for the full registration flow.

servers.description:
The EPOS Data REST API has no shared base URL: each EPOS provider hosts the
endpoints on their own domain and registers them against that base via
`PUT /epos/integrations/rest`. The placeholder `https://your-epos.example.com`
is illustrative — replace with your own publicly reachable HTTPS URL.

get.description: Retrieves all areas that are being served. Capability: `ListAreas`

post.description: Create an order on the EPOS. Capability: `CreateOrder`

get.description: Retrieve details of an order using the order ID. Capability: `GetOrderById`

delete.description: Cancels an order by ID. Capability: `CancelOrderById`

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: The ID of the order to retrieve.

200.description: Successful response with the order in its current state.

parameters.name: orderId

delete.description: Request to release a Dojo write lock on an EPOS Order, returning the latest version of the Order once unlocked. Capability: `DeleteOrderLock`

parameters.name: lockId
parameters.description: The unique ID of a lock generated by Dojo. Consuming this isn't strictly required as Dojo will create at most one lock per order, but it can be useful for tracking the lifecycle of any lock.

Cursor.title: Cursor
Cursor.description: A cursor for use in pagination.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to be returned in a single page.

before.description: A cursor for use in pagination for the previous page. before and after are mutually exclusive. Only one of these may be used.

after.description: A cursor for use in pagination for the next page. before and after are mutually exclusive. Only one of these may be used.

CreateOrderLockRequest.description: Request a write lock on an Order, guaranteeing only Dojo can write changes to the order, until receiving the corresponding UnlockOrder request.
CreateOrderLockRequest.title: CreateOrderLockRequest

lockId.description: The unique ID of a lock generated by Dojo. Consuming this isn't strictly required as Dojo will create at most one lock per order, but it can be useful for tracking the lifecycle of any lock.

expiry.description:
The lock expiry time. If this time has been reached and no UnlockOrder has been received the lock can be considered stale and released.
This may be extended by the ExtendOrderLockRequest if registered. It is optional to consume this expiry.
Dojo will always attempt to release or extend the lock before this expiry is reached, it exists to avoid stale locks if there is a full loss of communication between the EPOS and Dojo.

ExtendOrderLockRequest.description: Request an extension to the write lock on an Order.
ExtendOrderLockRequest.title: ExtendOrderLockRequest

expiry.description:
The lock expiry time. If this time has been reached and no UnlockOrder has been received the lock can be considered stale and released.
This may be extended by the ExtendOrderLockRequest if registered. It is optional to consume this expiry.
Dojo will always attempt to release or extend the lock before this expiry is reached, it exists to avoid stale locks if there is a full loss of communication between the EPOS and Dojo.

ExtendOrderLockResponse.description: Response for a write lock extension request
ExtendOrderLockResponse.title: ExtendOrderLockResponse

PartyDeposit.title: Party Deposit
PartyDeposit.description: Information about payments captured pre-arrival to secure the reservation.

totalAmount.description:
The deposit value of the party at the time it was seated. The common
flow for this field is that it is set by the Dojo VQ&B RMS shortly
after a party referring to a reservation (with a deposit) is
created.

description.description:
A human-readable description of the deposit. This may be used to
describe the reason for the deposit, or any other relevant information.

paymentIntentIds.description:
List of payment-intents that were captured to make the deposit.
Some may have been either partially or wholly refunded.

May not be edited by the EPOS partner.

Party.title: Party
Party.description:
The representation of a customer or group of customers _currently_
seated at/across a set of tables.

id.title: ID
id.description:
The EPOS-internal ID for this party. Must be globally unique within 
the EPOS' domain.

name.title: Name
name.description: The human-readable name, typically the name of the lead guest.

covers.title: Covers
covers.description: The number of covers this party occupies.

tableIds.title: Table IDs
tableIds.description: The set of tables this party is currently sat across.

status.title: Status
status.description:
An arbitrary description of the party's current status - typically 
used to show where in their journey the party is, such as 
"partially arrived", "ordered" or "paying"/"paid".

startTime.title: Start time
startTime.description:
The time the party was seated. ISO8601 formatted, millisecond
precision.

expectedEndTime.title: Expected end time
expectedEndTime.description:
The time the party is expected to depart, if known. ISO8601
formatted, millisecond precision.

endTime.title: Actual end time
endTime.description:
The time the party actually departed. ISO8601 formatted, millisecond
precision.

hostNotes.title: Host notes
hostNotes.description: Host-written notes about the party. Not surfaced to the Guest(s).

guestRequests.title: Guest requests
guestRequests.description:
Guest-written requests for the party. Surfaced to & editable by the 
Guest(s). May not be edited by the EPOS partner, as this may contain
dietary requirements set by the Guest.

reservationId.title: Reservation ID
reservationId.description:
If reservations are implemented & this party has an associated 
reservation, the EPOS-internal ID of the reservation this party 
corresponds to.

Reservation.title: Reservation
Reservation.description:
A reservation describes a point in the future that a party is expected
to be seated at, how long for, and where.

id.title: ID
id.description: The globally unique (within the EPOS) ID for the reservation.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the guest who the reservation is for.

covers.title: Covers
covers.description: The number of covers the reservation is expected to occupy.

startTime.title: Start time
startTime.description:
The time the reservation is expected to begin. ISO8601 formatted,
millisecond precision.

endTime.title: End time
endTime.description:
The time the reservation is expected to finish. ISO8601 formatted,
millisecond precision.

tableIds.title: Table IDs
tableIds.description: The tables the reservation is expected to occupy.

hostNotes.title: Host notes
hostNotes.description: Host-written notes about the reservation. Not exposed to guests.

guestRequests.title: Guest requests
guestRequests.description:
Guest-written requests for the reservation. Shown to & editable by
guests. May not be edited by the EPOS partner, as this may contain
dietary requirements set by the Guest.
